detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

No monitoring agent was ever installed & #Postgres is misbehaving mid-incident? @vyruss@fosstodon.org created radar for that: a Go binary that snapshots server & host in seconds, writes one zip, & exits. Metadata only.

A companion analyzer applies deterministic rules; an optional LLM writes the summary but can't soften verdicts. Both #OpenSource & PostgreSQL licensed.

Roberto Diniz covered it for iMasters, with a table of when to use each: 👉 https://imasters.com/banco-de-dados/pgconfeu-2026-postgres-radar-radar-analyst-diagnosis
